name: Abiram
description: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Korah, Dathan and Abiram, famous men in the congregation, rose up against Moses and Aaron, saying ye take too much upon you. Their rebellion was not overnight.

The congregation got up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram on every side; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood in the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little children.

What he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them up, their households, their tents, and all the substance in their possession, in the midst of all Israel.

note.label: Deuteronomy 11: Remember His Acts, Keep His Commandments
